allowed.reason: Adds network.denyMachLookup: macOS Mach services denied at the end of the Seatbelt profile, where they win over srt's built-in allows. sandbox-srt uses it to deny com.apple.SecurityServer and com.apple.securityd.xpc to the untrusted profile, so code in the fence can't read the Keychain (attack case A36, design HAL-958 section 6, HAL-6346). srt has allowMachLookup but no way to take a service away.
allowed.remove-when: srt can deny a Mach service itself (proposed upstream), or sandbox-srt no longer runs on Seatbelt
